children.text: Registration
Step 1: The applicant should visit the
ServicesPlus
website.
Step 2: Click on the “
Register”
option on the homepage.
Step 3: Fill out the registration form by entering Full Name, Email ID, Mobile Number, Password, selecting State, and Captcha.
Step 4: Review all details carefully and submit the registration form.
Step 5: An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number or email; enter the OTP and click “Verify.”
Step 6: Registration will be completed successfully, and a confirmation message will be displayed or sent via email.
Login

“Login.”
Step 2: Enter your Email ID, Password, and Captcha.
Step 3: Select the relevant service/scheme name.
Step 4: Fill in the required details in the application form.
Step 5: Submit the application.

basicDetails.schemeName: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom:  Small Cardamom Irrigation Land Development : Irrigation equipment (Nos.)

children.text: The applicant should be a small cardamom grower from the states of Kerala, Tamil Nadu, or Karnataka.
The applicant should install the approved irrigation equipment, and the installation must be inspected and recommended as eligible by the designated officials.

eligibilityCriteria.eligibilityDescription_md: 1. The applicant should be a small cardamom grower from the states of Kerala, Tamil Nadu, or Karnataka. 1. The applicant should install the approved irrigation equipment, and the installation must be inspected and recommended as eligible by the designated officials.

children.text: 50 % of cost of equipments subject to maximum of ₹ 5000 (Gen) and, ₹11250 (SC/ST) for Gravity; ₹15,000 (Gen) and ₹45,000 (SC/ST) for IP set and ₹ 32,000/- (Gen) and ₹ 95,000/- (SC/ST) for Sprinkler/ micro sprinkler sets.
Registered cardamom growers having land holding size of 0.10 Ha to 8 Ha are eligible for Gravity and Irrigation pump set (IP Set).
Registered cardamom growers having land holding size of 0.4 Ha to 8 Ha are eligible for Sprinklers / Drip / Microirrigation equipments.
Note:
Any farmer who has availed this benefit earlier is not eligible to avail the benefit.

schemeContent.briefDescription: The objective of the scheme is to encourage small cardamom growers to bring more area under irrigation and land development in order to increase productivity and improve the quality of small cardamom.

children.text: The scheme for Irrigation Equipment (Nos.) implemented by the Spices Board under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, and as per the modalities and scheme guidelines approved by the Competent Authority for the implementation of the “Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion and Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom” during the 15th Finance Commission period (2021–22 to 2025–26), financial assistance is provided to motivate growers to bring more area under irrigation and land development. The scheme aims to increase productivity and improve the quality of small cardamom through the adoption of different irrigation methods.
Assistance is provided for the installation of the following equipment:
(a) Gravity Irrigation Equipment,
(b) Irrigation Pump Sets (IP Sets), and
(c) Sprinkler, Drip, and Micro-sprinkler Sets.

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: The scheme for Irrigation Equipment (Nos.) implemented by the Spices Board under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, and as per the modalities and scheme guidelines approved by the Competent Authority for the implementation of the “Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion and Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom” during the 15th Finance Commission period (2021–22 to 2025–26), financial assistance is provided to motivate growers to bring more area under irrigation and land development. The scheme aims to increase productivity and improve the quality of small cardamom through the adoption of different irrigation methods. **Assistance is provided for the installation of the following equipment:** (a) Gravity Irrigation Equipment, (b) Irrigation Pump Sets (IP Sets), and (c) Sprinkler, Drip, and Micro-sprinkler Sets.
